rationale: Preserve the existing low/mid/high overnight capital-intensity sensitivity; 12000 is a central test value, not a fitted Stellaris estimate.
range_rationale: 8000 and 18000 bound existing CAL001-CAL003. Their order of magnitude is contextualized by unconverted literature only; they are not inferred EUR confidence bounds.
dependencies: Power, plant scope, FOAK manufacturing, contingency, maintenance/reliability requirements and financing boundary.
next_evidence_needed: Obtain a component cost breakdown and normalize literature currency, price year, country and first/repeat-unit scope.

rationale: 1000 MWe is the retained net-rated analyst reference. Similarity to published peak electric output is not evidence of net output.
range_rationale: 800/1000/1200 MWe are the existing fixed-total-CAPEX output sensitivities. This is an exploratory plus/minus 20% bracket.
dependencies: Auxiliary loads and gross/net boundary; intensity scenarios scale CAPEX with power, while the separate power test holds total CAPEX fixed.
next_evidence_needed: Resolve complete plant power balance, conversion efficiency, auxiliary demand and rated versus peak output.

rationale: Retain 85% as the utilization reference to study fixed-cost recovery; it is not a commercial reliability prediction.
range_rationale: 70-95% spans the existing performance grid. The upper point is a stretch sensitivity, not validated under the current maintenance regime.
dependencies: Planned and unplanned outages, derating, replacement intervals, dispatch and reference net power.
next_evidence_needed: Build maintenance/reliability-constrained scenario families in Step 5; justify every high-CF combination.

rationale: Retain the existing 200 million EUR/year aggregate fixed-OPEX placeholder to isolate other sensitivities; no commercial cost support is claimed.
range_rationale: 100-300 is an analyst plus/minus 50% stress bracket. These endpoints are newly documented candidates, not newly executed scenarios or empirical bounds.
dependencies: Staffing, insurance, maintenance scope, regulatory requirements, plant scale and cost classification.
next_evidence_needed: Build a bottom-up fixed-OPEX estimate and distinguish routine work from separately modeled major replacements.

rationale: Retain the existing aggregate variable-OPEX placeholder. It is not a verified fuel, tritium or blanket-cycle cost.
range_rationale: 0-10 tests removal versus doubling of the 5 EUR/MWh placeholder. Zero is a mathematical sensitivity endpoint, not a plausible fusion fuel-cost assertion.
dependencies: Fuel cycle, consumables, output boundary and whether replacement costs are modeled separately.
next_evidence_needed: Disaggregate variable expenses and prevent double counting with replacement and fuel-cycle costs.

rationale: Retain 35 years as an economic operating-horizon assumption, not a demonstrated component or plant lifetime.
range_rationale: 25-45 years is a symmetric plus/minus 10-year analyst stress bracket; no survival distribution is inferred.
dependencies: Component replacement, license renewal, degradation, construction/operation dates and terminal costs.
next_evidence_needed: Separate plant economic life from short-lived components and obtain defensible operating-horizon scenarios.

rationale: Retain 8% as a real pre-tax unlevered hurdle-rate sensitivity reference; it is not an estimated Proxima WACC.
range_rationale: 4-12% is an analyst plus/minus 4 percentage-point bracket to explore discount sensitivity. No capital-market calibration is claimed.
dependencies: Risk allocation, commissioning stage, offtake, construction risk and consistency of taxes/leverage/nominal-real treatment.
next_evidence_needed: Develop financing scenarios with explicit risk allocation and real/nominal assumptions; avoid interpreting the hurdle rate as measured WACC.

rationale: Retain a 25% learnable magnet CAPEX share as an illustrative subsystem allocation, not a manufacturer cost breakdown.
range_rationale: 10-40% is an analyst plus/minus 15 percentage-point bracket. Current executed learning scenarios hold the share at 25%.
dependencies: Plant cost breakdown, structural/cryogenic boundaries and capital intensity; share and learning effects are coupled.
next_evidence_needed: Obtain a consistent subsystem cost breakdown and identify the cost categories actually subject to repeat-production learning.

rationale: 10% is the moderate illustrative case; 0% and 20% are existing alternatives. No stellarator-specific empirical learning rate is claimed.
range_rationale: 0-20% spans the executed component-learning cases. Rates apply per doubling of equivalent plant-scale magnet sets, not to total plant CAPEX.
dependencies: Magnet share, standardization, yield, cumulative deployment, factory investment and changes in design.
next_evidence_needed: Find relevant manufacturing evidence, estimate industrial investment and justify transferability and cumulative production levels.

rationale: 170 is the retained hypothetical fixed real sale-price case. Only REV001=78.51 is a historical observation; 120/170/200 are analyst stress tests.
range_rationale: 78.51-200 spans the current mixed historical/hypothetical price cases. It is not a forecast range or an empirical distribution of future plant revenues.
dependencies: Offtake contract, market participation, generation profile, future market year and real-price convention.
next_evidence_needed: Develop future PPA/merchant scenarios and generation-weighted revenues; do not freeze one historical year as a price forecast.
